level_names.admin1: oblys (region) or city of republican significance

tips.livery: bus colour is not a city marker in Kazakhstan: one city runs several liveries at once and they change with each fleet renewal. Read the route number, operator name and the plate's region code from the bus instead (`clues.py lookup plate <two digits> --country kz`); in Astana the bus generation dates the photo (clues.md, Public transport)
